rules.statement: In a rei vindicatio action, the burden of proof is on the defendant to show that he is in lawful possession, once the plaintiff's legal title to the corpus is proved.
rules.supporting_quote: Where the legal title to the corpus is proved, the burden of proof is on the Respondent to show that he is in lawful possession [Theivandran v. Ramanathan Chettiar (1986) 2 Sri LR 219 at 222; Wijetunge v. Thangarajah (1999) 1 Sri LR 53 at 55; Candappa Nee Bastian v. Ponnambalampillai (1993) 1 Sri LR 184 at 187; Beebi Johara v. Warusavithana (1998) 3 Sri LR 227 at 228].
